lines.en: label utamaid1:
scene utafirstmaidcafe1
I walk into the maid cafe to find it pretty much deserted- which I guess makes sense considering that they close in around an hour.
lines.zh: 我走进女仆咖啡厅，发现店里几乎空无一人——想想还有大约一小时就要打烊，倒也说得通。

lines.en: There’s a little bell near where you walk in that I guess they want you to ring in the event of something like this happening, but...
lines.zh: 入口旁边摆着一只小铃铛，我猜他们是想让客人在发生这种事时摇一摇，不过……

lines.en: I am a man.
lines.zh: 我是个男人。

lines.en: I shall ring no bell.
lines.zh: 我绝不摇铃。

lines.en: I will remain standing right here until a maid emerges from the kitchen and awkwardly discovers that there is someone waiting to be taken advantage of.
lines.zh: 我就这么站定在这儿，直到某位女仆从后厨走出来，尴尬地发现有个人正等着被宰。

lines.en: : Uta-chan’s maid-senses are tingling! Someone has arrived!
lines.zh: : Uta 酱的女仆感应正在发麻！有客人来啦！

lines.en: That someone is me.
lines.zh: 那个客人就是我。

lines.en: She could probably sense my unrivaled love for her.
lines.zh: 她大概是感应到了我对她那份无可匹敌的爱。

lines.en: scene utafirstmaidcafe2
: Ah! Sen- Master! You came to visit me!
lines.zh: : 啊！老——Master！您来看我啦！

lines.en: : Woah. Did you almost break character just now?
lines.zh: : 哇哦。你刚才差点出戏了吧？

lines.en: : Uta-chan is the perfect maid who never breaks character and makes all of her masters leave with full hearts and full tummies!
lines.zh: : Uta 酱是完美的女仆，绝不出戏，还会让每一位主人都带着满满的心和满满的胃离开！

lines.en: : And, in return, she gets to leave with a full coinpurse!
lines.zh: : 而作为回报，她也能带着鼓鼓的钱袋子离开！

lines.en: : That last part didn’t seem like a very maid-like thing to say.
lines.zh: : 最后那句听起来可不太像女仆该说的话。

lines.en: scene utafirstmaidcafe3
: Sorry, Master. I just feel so comfortable around you that I guess I let a little bit of my true self slip.
lines.zh: : 对不起，Master。只是在您身边我太放松了，一不小心就漏出了一点真实的自己。

lines.en: : Teehee~
lines.zh: : 嘻嘻~

lines.en: : God, you’re good at this.
lines.zh: : 天哪，你也太擅长这个了。

lines.en: scene utafirstmaidcafe4
: I like taking care of people.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢照顾人。

lines.en: : I talked about it in class but I was looking after my grandpa before coming here.
lines.zh: : 我在班上说过，来这儿之前我一直在照顾我爷爷。

lines.en: : Most people would probably get bothered by something like that after a while but I thought it was kinda fun!
lines.zh: : 换成大多数人，时间久了大概都会觉得烦，可我觉得还挺有意思的！

lines.en: : Like taking care of a baby except the baby is like four times your age and smokes cigarettes.
lines.zh: : 就像照顾小宝宝，只不过这个宝宝的年纪是你四倍，还抽烟。

lines.en: : Ahh, yes. I can totally see the correlation.
lines.zh: : 啊，是。这关联我完全看得出来。

lines.en: scene utafirstmaidcafe5
: Good! Cause today, since nobody else is around, Master gets Uta-chan all to himself!
lines.zh: : 太好了！因为今天没有别人在，Master 可以独占 Uta 酱一个人！

lines.en: : I’ll be sure to make you even happier than I used to make grandpa before the cancer spread.
lines.zh: : 我一定会让您比以前更开心——比爷爷的癌细胞扩散之前我让他开心还要开心。

lines.en: She doesn’t even realize how dark that was, does she?
lines.zh: 她自己都没意识到那句话有多阴暗吧？

lines.en: : You sure that’s okay? I feel kind of bad for showing up so late in hindsight- like you’re supposed to be cleaning right now or something.
lines.zh: : 真的没问题吗？事后想想，我来得这么晚还挺过意不去的——你现在大概该在做打扫什么的吧。

lines.en: : Of course it’s okay! I’m not really supposed to be spending so much time in the back anyway.
lines.zh: : 当然没问题！反正我本来也不该在后头待那么久。

lines.en: : I need a stepping stool to reach most of the stuff back there and it’s led to a few more broken glasses and dishes than I’d like to admit.
lines.zh: : 后面大部分东西我都得踩着小凳子才够得着，结果打碎的杯子和盘子比我愿意承认的还要多几个。

lines.en: : But it’s no fun talking about things like that when you’re here to unwind! Come take a load off, Master! I’ll sit you down at my favorite table!
lines.zh: : 不过您是来放松的，聊这些多没意思！快坐下歇歇，Master！我把您安排到我最喜欢的那张桌子！

lines.en: scene black
Uta breaks the no-contact policy she informed me of the first time I came here and grabs my wrist, pulling me to a table near the window.
lines.zh: Uta 打破了我第一次来时她跟我讲过的「禁止接触」规矩，一把抓住我的手腕，把我拉到靠窗的一张桌子旁。

lines.en: She doesn’t sit down beside me. But she {i}does{/i} slam her hands down onto the table like some sort of detective interrogating a murder suspect.
lines.zh: 她没有在我旁边坐下。但她{i}确实{/i}把双手重重拍在桌上，活像个审问凶案嫌疑人的侦探。

lines.en: scene utafirstmaidcafe6
: So, Master...how can I make your dreams come true today?
lines.zh: : 那么，Master……今天我该怎么让您美梦成真呢？

lines.en: : You can start by calling your parents.
lines.zh: : 你可以先给你父母打个电话。

lines.en: : Sorry, Master. I can’t talk about things that frisky while I’m on the clock.
lines.zh: : 对不起，Master。上班时间我不能聊那么荤的话题。

lines.en: : Unfortunately, Uta-chan will have to reject you once again.
lines.zh: : 遗憾的是，Uta 酱只好再一次拒绝您了。

lines.en: : But if there is anything slightly more legal that you’re interested in, all you need to do is let me know!
lines.zh: : 不过如果您感兴趣的是稍微合法一点的事情，只要您开口就行！

lines.en: : I can just wait an hour or two until you’re off the clock. It’s fine.
lines.zh: : 我可以等你一两个小时，等你下班。没关系的。

lines.en: : Such determination. You’re really cute when you set your sights on something, Master!
lines.zh: : 好坚定的决心。Master 一旦盯上什么，真的特别可爱！

lines.en: : I’m not weirded out at all!
lines.zh: : 我可一点都没觉得瘆人！

lines.en: : Saying that makes me feel like you are...
lines.zh: : 你越这么说，我越觉得你是……

lines.en: : Hey, know what’s even better than all of those dirty thoughts you’re having right now, Master?
lines.zh: : 话说，Master，您知道有什么比您现在脑子里那些下流的念头还棒吗？

lines.en: : ...Nothing?
: A nice...hot...plate of dinner!
lines.zh: : 一份香喷喷……热腾腾……的晚餐！

lines.en: : That’s not really better but I guess I’ll have to settle for it.
lines.zh: : 那也算不上更棒，不过看来我只能将就了。

lines.en: scene utafirstmaidcafe7
: Do you need a menu? Or do you want me to just have them make you something I know you’ll fall in love with?
lines.zh: : 您需要菜单吗？还是说，要不要我让后厨给您做一道我知道您一定会爱上的？

lines.en: : Besides me, I mean~
lines.zh: : 我指的是，除了我之外~

lines.en: : Uta, I want you to know that you make it very hard to not flirt with you when you say things like that.
lines.zh: : Uta，我想让你知道，你说这种话的时候，我很难忍住不跟你调情。

lines.en: : Of course. That’s the whole point of places like this, silly.
lines.zh: : 那当然啦。这种地方的意义就在这儿呀，傻瓜。

lines.en: : I say things to make you feel good and, in return, you spend all of your money on little-ole Uta-chan so she can buy more socks and underwear.
lines.zh: : 我说些让您开心的话，作为回报，您就把所有的钱都花在小小的 Uta 酱身上，好让她多买点袜子和内衣。

lines.en: : And I’m guessing you tacked underwear onto the end of that as another part of the maid-strategy?
lines.zh: : 我猜你特意把内衣放在最后说，也是女仆攻略的一部分？

lines.en: : It worked, right? Are you thinking about my panties now?
lines.zh: : 奏效了对吧？您现在是不是在想我的内裤？

lines.en: : It makes you want to spend more money on me, right?
lines.zh: : 是不是让您更想在我身上花钱了？

lines.en: I look down at the table to find that I’ve already begun subconsciously sliding my wallet toward Uta.
lines.zh: 我低头看向桌面，发现自己已经下意识地把钱包往 Uta 那边推过去了。

lines.en: : When did this even happen?
lines.zh: : 这到底是什么时候发生的？

lines.en: : You reached into your pocket the second I said underwear.
lines.zh: : 我一说内衣，您的手就伸进口袋了。

lines.en: : Even girls do that sometimes. It’s kinda crazy how well it works.
lines.zh: : 有时候连女孩子都会这样。效果好得都有点邪门。

lines.en: : I guess I’m pretty good at this, huh?
lines.zh: : 看来我还挺擅长这行的，对吧？

lines.en: : Yes. You’re going to bankrupt me one day.
lines.zh: : 是啊。总有一天你会让我破产的。

lines.en: scene utafirstmaidcafe8
: Uta-chan can’t help it if Master lets his mind wander. But as long as he’s happy and keeps his hands to himself, he can do whatever he likes.
lines.zh: : Master 自己心思乱飘，Uta 酱也没办法。不过只要他开心、而且安分守己，他想干什么都行。

lines.en: : And, in the meantime, I’ll go put your order in! Try not to stare at my butt as I walk away, okay?
lines.zh: : 那么，我先去给您下单啦！我走开的时候，尽量不要盯着我的屁股看哦？

lines.en: : My skirt’s a little short today so I’m kinda worried you might accidentally catch a peek~
lines.zh: : 今天我的裙子有点短，所以有点担心您会不小心瞥见什么~

lines.en: : Are you actually a genius, Uta?
lines.zh: : Uta，你该不会其实是个天才吧？

lines.en: scene utafirstmaidcafe9
: Just a maid~ We’re all like this.
lines.zh: : 只是个女仆罢了~ 我们这行都这样的。

lines.en: : Ami will be exactly like me soon. Just you watch.
lines.zh: : Ami 很快也会变得跟我一模一样。您等着瞧吧。

lines.en: scene utafirstmaidcafe10
Uta walks away and I realize that her skirt isn’t any shorter than normal. I know this for sure because I {i}always{/i} stare at her as she walks away.
lines.zh: Uta 走开了，我这才意识到她的裙子根本不比平时短。我之所以能肯定，是因为她走开的时候我{i}每次{/i}都盯着看。

lines.en: I’ve been deceived.
lines.zh: 我被骗了。

lines.en: And also, now I have to worry that Ami will be using these same tricks on me soon.
lines.zh: 而且现在我还得多操一份心：Ami 很快也要用同样这招对付我了。

lines.en: This is no haven for degenerates. It’s a prison.
lines.zh: 这里根本不是什么废柴的避风港。是座监狱。

lines.en: It sucks us in under the false pretenses of cute girls who will unconditionally care about us-
lines.zh: 它打着「会有可爱女孩无条件照顾你」的幌子把我们吸进来——

lines.en: When in all actuality, it’s just a cash-vacuum that they use and abuse until they can line their pockets with our hard-earned money.
lines.zh: 而实际上，它不过是一台吸尘器，被她们反复滥用，把我们辛苦挣来的钱吸得一干二净，好塞满她们自己的口袋。

lines.en: I shall not be defeated by a place like this.
lines.zh: 我绝不会败在这种地方手里。

lines.en: I am a man.
lines.zh: 我是个男人。

lines.en: I didn’t even ring the bell.
lines.zh: 我连铃都没摇。

lines.en: All I have to do is hold out a little while longer...
lines.zh: 我只要再撑一会儿就好了……

lines.en: scene black
scene utafirstmaidcafe11
Uta comes back several minutes later with a plate of omurice, but instead of blessing it with the ritualistic flavor-beam, she sits across from me and presses her fingers together.
lines.zh: 几分钟后，Uta 端着一盘蛋包饭回来了，但她没有举行那套仪式性的「美味光线」加祝福，而是在我对面坐下，把十指对合在一起。

lines.en: This time it feels less like the work of a criminal-investigator and more like some sort of...seductive older woman.
lines.zh: 这一次给人的感觉不像犯罪调查员，倒更像某种……勾人的成熟女人。

lines.en: : You know, Master. It just occurred to me while I was in the kitchen that I can {i}really{/i} take advantage of you if I want.
lines.zh: : 您知道的，Master。我在后厨的时候突然想到，只要我愿意，{i}真的{/i}可以好好利用您一番。

lines.en: : Have you not already been doing that?
lines.zh: : 你不是一直都在这么做吗？

lines.en: : Of course not. Uta-chan’s been nothing but affectionate and attentive toward you.
lines.zh: : 当然没有。Uta 酱对您可一直是又亲又贴心啊。

lines.en: : She even went as far as infusing all of the love in her little heart into this omelette.
lines.zh: : 她甚至把小小心脏里全部的爱都注进了这份蛋包饭里。

lines.en: : If you’re looking for more money, I don’t know what else I’d even be able to give-
lines.zh: : 如果你还想要更多钱，我真不知道自己还能给出什么——

lines.en: scene utafirstmaidcafe12
: Calm down. I’m not actually going to do anything.
lines.zh: : 冷静点。我不会真干什么的。

lines.en: : You say that, but I have a hard time believing this isn’t part of your scheme as well.
lines.zh: : 你嘴上这么说，可我很难相信这也不是你计划的一部分。

lines.en: scene utafirstmaidcafe13
: Heheh~ It’s not. Really.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿~ 真的不是。我说真的。

lines.en: : I was just thinking that it’s a little risky for someone working in public education to even come to a maid cafe this close to the[school] in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我只是在想，一个在公立教育系统里工作的人，跑到离[school]这么近的女仆咖啡厅来，本身就挺冒险的。

lines.en: : The only reason I got a job here instead of somewhere closer to my old[school] was that I was worried about being caught.
lines.zh: : 我没在离我原来那所[school]更近的地方找活儿，唯一的理由就是怕被抓到。

lines.en: : But here you are, an actual teacher, throwing all of his money at Uta-chan and thinking about her underwear and stuff.
lines.zh: : 可您呢，一个货真价实的老师，把所有的钱都砸在 Uta 酱身上，还净想着她的内裤什么的。

lines.en: scene utafirstmaidcafe14
: Aren’t you worried about getting caught?
lines.zh: : 您就不怕被抓到吗？

lines.en: : Like, what if a girl from a different class saw you here and ratted you out to one of the other teachers or something?
lines.zh: : 比如说，万一别的班有女孩在这儿看见您，然后跑去跟别的老师告密什么的？

lines.en: : Well...that would probably make me look bad. But I think they’d also be revealing that they have a job in the process, so they’d be effectively ratting themselves out as well.
lines.zh: : 嗯……那大概会让我很没面子。但我觉得她们这么做的同时，也等于暴露了自己有工作，所以其实也算把自己给卖了。

lines.en: scene utafirstmaidcafe15
: Wait, are we not allowed to have jobs at this[school]?
lines.zh: : 等等，这所[school]不许我们打工吗？

lines.en: : My other one was fine with them as long as they were part-time and we kept our grades up.
lines.zh: : 我原来那所是允许的，只要是兼职、而且成绩不掉就行。

lines.en: : Oh, wait! You’re actually here to blackmail Uta-chan, aren’t you?!
lines.zh: : 哦，等等！您其实是来敲诈 Uta 酱的吧？！

lines.en: : You want to get freaky with her so badly that you’re abusing your power because you know you can get her on her back-foot!
lines.zh: : 您太想跟她乱来了，所以就滥用职权，因为您知道这样能让她措手不及！

lines.en: : Or even worse- her back!
lines.zh: : 甚至更糟——让她仰面朝天！

lines.en: : ...While the desire to “get freaky with you” may almost certainly be true-
lines.zh: : ……虽然「想跟你乱来」这个念头几乎可以肯定是真的——

lines.en: : Almost?! Uta-chan’s not even a definite candidate in her ultimate form?!
lines.zh: : 几乎？！Uta 酱的终极形态居然连个确定名额都排不上？！

lines.en: : ...I have no intention of blackmailing you.
lines.zh: : ……我没打算敲诈你。

lines.en: : You keep my presence here a secret and I’ll keep yours a secret in return.
lines.zh: : 你替我保密我来过这儿，我也替你保密，就这么说定了。

lines.en: scene utafirstmaidcafe16
: Ah! Back-scratching! It’s finally shown up!
lines.zh: : 啊！互相挠背！这个词儿终于出现了！

lines.en: : That’s right. We’re both breaking rules by being here, so the least we can do is help each other continue to break them instead of abiding by them.
lines.zh: : 没错。我们俩出现在这里，都是在违规，所以我们至少该帮着对方继续违规，而不是乖乖守规矩。

lines.en: : I agree. Rules are dumb. Like, there’s that one rule at the mall where you can’t even bring more than like five things into the dressing room at once.
lines.zh: : 我同意。规矩最蠢了。比如说商场里就有一条，试衣间一次还不准带超过五件东西进去。

lines.en: : But what if I wanna try on more than five things? You know?
lines.zh: : 可我要是想试五件以上呢？你说是不是？

lines.en: : And also, what’s the deal with not being able to use your cell-phone on planes? I hate rules.
lines.zh: : 还有，飞机上不许用手机又是什么道理？我讨厌规矩。

lines.en: : None of that really has anything to do with what I was trying to say, but I feel you.
lines.zh: : 这些跟我刚才想说的其实都没什么关系，不过我懂你。

lines.en: scene utafirstmaidcafe17
: Whaaaat? You want to {i}feel{/i} me? Master! Keep your voice down.
lines.zh: : 什——么？您想{i}摸{/i}我？Master！小声点呀。

lines.en: : You know, that’s not what I meant, but it’s true so there’s no sense in denying it.
lines.zh: : 你知道的，我本来不是那个意思，但那确实是实话，否认也没意义。

lines.en: : I would like to “feel” you immediately, if at all possible.
lines.zh: : 如果可以的话，我想立刻「摸」你。

lines.en: scene utafirstmaidcafe18
: Wait, no. It feels kinda weird if you just go along with it like that.
lines.zh: : 等等，不对。您就这么顺着接下去，感觉怪怪的。

lines.en: : We’re supposed to keep going back and forth for a little while and then I’m supposed to shoot you down and apologize.
lines.zh: : 我们应该先来回过上几招，然后我再拒绝您、再道歉才对。

lines.en: : You’re breakin’ out of the pattern here. Next thing I know, you’re going to be telling me you weren’t even staring at my butt as I walked away.
lines.zh: : 您这是打破套路了。再这么下去，您下一句怕不是要说，我走开的时候您根本没盯着我的屁股看。

lines.en: : Oh, I can guarantee that I was doing just that.
lines.zh: : 哦，这一点我可以保证，我确实在盯着看。

lines.en: : Your skirt is also the same size as always.
lines.zh: : 你的裙子长度也和平时一样。

lines.en: scene utafirstmaidcafe19
: Stooooooooop right there, Master!
lines.zh: : 就到此为——止，Master！

lines.en: : As flattered as I am to hear that you think I’m cute enough to stare at me as I walk away, I’m afraid that I can’t let things go any further.
lines.zh: : 您觉得我可爱到会盯着我走开的样子看，我当然很受宠若惊，但恐怕我不能让事情再往下发展了。

lines.en: : So I am sorry but, once again, I must reject you. Please do not hold this against me or take it out on my report card.
lines.zh: : 所以很抱歉，我必须再一次拒绝您。请您别往心里去，也别记到我的成绩单上。

lines.en: : I am willing to do several special things to increase my grades after hours but probably not the things you want me to do.
lines.zh: : 下了班之后，为了加分我还是愿意做一些「特别的事」的，不过大概不是您想要的那种。

lines.en: : What does that even mean? What sort of things would you do to increase your grades?
lines.zh: : 这到底是什么意思？为了加分你会做什么样的事？

lines.en: : I can’t tell you that or you’ll lower them on purpose. Please forget I said anything and enjoy your omurice.
lines.zh: : 这个我不能说，不然您会故意给我打低分。请当我什么都没说过，好好享用您的蛋包饭吧。

lines.en: : It was made with love. Lots of love. All of the love in my tiny body.
lines.zh: : 它是用爱做的。好多好多的爱。我小小的身体里全部的爱。

lines.en: scene utafirstmaidcafe20
: Heheh~
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿~

lines.en: : Talking to you is fun.
lines.zh: : 跟您聊天很开心。

lines.en: : And I’m not just saying that as Uta-chan.
lines.zh: : 而且这话不是只有站在 Uta 酱的立场才说的。

lines.en: : Did you ever get annoyed with me those first few days I transferred in? How I stuck to your side the whole time?
lines.zh: : 我转学过来的头几天，您有没有嫌我烦过？就是我整天黏在您身边那阵子？

lines.en: : Annoyed? Not really.
lines.zh: : 嫌烦？倒也不至于。

lines.en: : You talk a lot but it’s not like you do anything that actually disrupts my day.
lines.zh: : 你是话多，但也没做什么真正打乱我一天的事。

lines.en: : Well, that’s good. I’m glad I asked.
lines.zh: : 那就好。还好我问了。

lines.en: scene utafirstmaidcafe14
: Question, and you can say no if it makes you feel weird, but did you maybe want to give me a ride back to the dorm after this?
lines.zh: : 问个问题，如果让您觉得别扭可以拒绝——待会儿您能不能捎我回宿舍？

lines.en: : I’m still new-ish to the area and not totally comfortable going alone yet.
lines.zh: : 我对这一带还不太熟，一个人走还是有点不踏实。

lines.en: : Io was gonna come meet me but I’m pretty sure she fell asleep or something.
lines.zh: : Io 本来要来接我的，不过我猜她大概是睡着了什么的。

lines.en: : I don't have a car, so I can't give you a ride. But we can walk back if you'd like.
lines.zh: : 我没有车，所以没法开车送你。不过你愿意的话，我们可以一起走回去。

lines.en: scene utafirstmaidcafe15
: An adult without a car?!
lines.zh: : 一个大人居然没有车？！

lines.en: : This is the city. We don’t really {i}need{/i} cars with all the public transportation here.
lines.zh: : 这可是城里。公共交通这么发达，我们其实{i}用不上{/i}车。

lines.en: : Oh right. I’m not in the country anymore.
lines.zh: : 哦对。我现在不在乡下了。

lines.en: : Well then, did you want to walk back with me instead?
lines.zh: : 那，您愿意陪我走回去吗？

lines.en: : As long as I have some big guy like you next to me, I’ll feel a lot safer.
lines.zh: : 只要有您这样的大块头走在我旁边，我就会安心很多。

lines.en: : That crazy brawl with Yumi really gave me a wake-up call about how weak I am.
lines.zh: : 跟 Yumi 那场惊天动地的打斗，真的让我清醒地意识到自己有多弱。

lines.en: : That crazy brawl was a two-second arm-wrestle, but sure. I’ll walk back with you.
lines.zh: : 那场惊天动地的打斗不过是两秒钟的掰手腕，不过好吧，我陪你走回去。

lines.en: scene utafirstmaidcafe16
: Yay!
lines.zh: : 好耶！

lines.en: : But remember, no holding my hand unless I ask you to.
lines.zh: : 不过记住，除非我主动要求，不然不准牵我的手。

lines.en: : Right. Keep my hands in the vehicle at all times. You’ve said that before.
lines.zh: : 明白。双手全程放在车里。这话你之前说过。

lines.en: : Yes. Uta-chan is not for sale.
lines.zh: : 是的。Uta 酱是非卖品。

lines.en: : Unless you hire me to come clean your room or your house or something. I’d probably do that for you.
lines.zh: : 除非您雇我去打扫您的房间或者屋子什么的。那个我大概会帮您做。

lines.en: : Ami normally handles all of that, but I’ll let you know if she just suddenly...stops for some reason.
lines.zh: : 这些平时都是 Ami 做的，不过要是她哪天突然……因为什么原因不干了，我会告诉你的。

lines.en: : Works for me!
lines.zh: : 就这么说定了！

lines.en: : Now- dig in, Master! Your food’s probably cold by now!
lines.zh: : 好了——快吃吧，Master！您的饭这会儿大概都凉了！

lines.en: scene black
I hang around the cafe for the next hour until it’s time for Uta to leave.
lines.zh: 接下来的一个小时我就在咖啡厅里耗着，直到 Uta 该下班的时间。

lines.en: The two of us walk back together and she tells me a little bit more about what life in Nara was like.
lines.zh: 我们一起走回去，路上她又跟我多讲了一些在奈良的生活是什么样的。

lines.en: Apparently, before she came here to take care of her grandfather, she also did all of the cooking and cleaning around the house.
lines.zh: 据说在来这儿照顾爷爷之前，家里的做饭和打扫也全都是她一个人包了。

lines.en: She seems a bit worried about how they’re all getting on without her over there, but it doesn’t seem to break her spirit at all.
lines.zh: 她似乎有点担心那边没有她会过得怎么样，但这似乎完全没有打击到她的精神。

lines.en: Eventually, we make it back to the dorm and she trots up the stairs, thanking me again for bringing her back.
lines.zh: 最后我们回到了宿舍，她小跑着上了楼，又谢了我一次送她回来。

lines.en: Then, the next thing I know, I’m headed back home to a {i}different{/i} maid.
lines.zh: 然后等我回过神来，我已经在回家的路上，而家里还有{i}另一位{/i}女仆在等着。

lines.en: Life sure has gotten interesting lately.
lines.zh: 最近的日子确实变得有意思起来了。
